headline: Nevish Line Surges While Expanse Battle Cools
war_summary: Since the evening edition the Nevish Line has taken the lead with fifteen transfers in two hours and forty-three on the day about Blackcoat Way, Blinding Stones and Princefal for five Warden, two Colonial and one destroyed holding, last at the midnight wire, while Linn Mercy holds steady with four in two hours and twenty-four on the day about Lathair and Outwich Ranch for eight Colonial and three destroyed, also last at the wire. The Weathered Expanse has eased to three in two hours and fifty-two on the day about Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and Necropolis for three Warden, two Colonial and four destroyed, last at 2326, and Marban Hollow has cooled to one in two hours and twenty-six on the day about Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall for four Warden, three Colonial and one destroyed, last at 2256. Mooring County shows one in two hours and eleven on the day about the Wind Hills, now listed with twelve Warden holdings, last at 2211. Stonecradle, Kuura Strand and Stlican Shelf record nothing in two hours, while Callahan's Passage reports 8,826 Colonial and 6,390 Warden casualties on the day with no recorded transfer.
